title: IndianStandardRecord
description: Comprehensive schema representing a verified Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) standard record.

title.description: Official title as published by the Bureau of Indian Standards.

scope.description: Official scope text outlining the applicability and technical boundaries of the standard.

category.description: Broad BIS engineering domain (e.g., 'Civil Engineering', 'Electrotechnical', 'Metallurgical Engineering', 'Chemical').

product_types.description: List of equipment, materials, or items governed by this standard.

keywords.description: Keywords and technical synonyms for hybrid retrieval indexing.

status.description: Official lifecycle status of this standard.

current_version.description: Full current designation with reaffirmation/revision year (e.g., 'IS 2062:2011').

publication_year.description: Year of initial publication or latest major revision.

amendments.description: Official gazetted amendments issued for this standard.

supersedes.description: List of earlier standard codes or editions replaced by this standard.

superseded_by.description: The newer standard code that replaced this standard if status is SUPERSEDED.

withdrawn_reason.description: Official technical committee reason for withdrawal if status is WITHDRAWN.

normative_references.description: Standards indispensable for the application of this document.

test_standards.description: Standardized laboratory test methods referenced for verification of parameters.

safety_standards.description: Safety guidelines, insulation protocols, or hazardous condition codes.

installation_standards.description: Codes of practice for erection, installation, and field commissioning.

related_standards.description: allied/related standards not already represented by one of the specific relationship categories.

structured_parameters.description: Parametric specifications, limits, and tolerances defined within this standard.

last_verified.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was last verified against official portals.

superseded_by.description: The newer standard code that replaced this standard (required when status is SUPERSEDED).

withdrawn_reason.description: Official technical committee reason for withdrawal (required when status is WITHDRAWN).

gazette_notification.description: Official gazette publication reference if published.

summary.description: Technical summary of modifications introduced by this amendment.

StandardParameter.description: Standardized physical, chemical, or operational tolerance.

parameter_name.description: Canonical name (e.g., 'Tensile Strength', 'Elongation at Break', 'Conductor Resistance').

governing_clause.description: Clause in the standard stipulating this parameter (e.g., 'Table 2, Clause 8.1').

requirement_text.description: Full textual requirement from the standard.

test_method_standard.description: Specific testing standard to be used (e.g., 'IS 1608 (Part 1)').

test_method_clause.description: Specific clause of the test method.

notes.description: Application notes or exceptions (e.g., based on thickness or temperature).

CertificationScheme.description: BIS conformity assessment scheme governing this product.

scheme.description: Governing BIS scheme (e.g., 'Scheme I - ISI Mark (Product Certification)', 'Scheme II - Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS)', 'Voluntary Certification').

is_mandatory.description: True if certification is statutorily mandatory prior to sale or procurement.

certification_body.description: Accredited conformity assessment body (e.g., 'Bureau of Indian Standards').

applicable_provisions.description: Relevant section of BIS Act 2016 or BIS Conformity Assessment Regulations 2018.

is_covered_by_qco.description: Whether a statutory QCO has been notified for this standard.

qco_title.description: Official title of the notification (e.g., 'Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order, 2020').

issuing_ministry.description: Government ministry or department issuing the order (e.g., 'Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade', 'Ministry of Steel').

gazette_date.description: Date of notification in the Gazette of India.

effective_date.description: Date on which the QCO entered into force.

isi_mark_mandatory.description: True if goods cannot be manufactured, imported, or procured without ISI mark.

exemption_provisions.description: Provisions for export exemptions, R&D exemptions, or micro/small enterprises.

ProvenanceRecord.description: Mandatory provenance record tracing regulatory and standard information back to official sources.

portal_url.description: URL to official source record (e.g., Manakonline portal or Gazette repository).

gazette_citation.description: Official Gazette publication volume, part, and number if statutory.

official_publication_ref.description: Official catalog citation or publication reference code.

verified_by.description: Identity or role of verified reviewer.
